targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r.kind == "daily" and r.direction == "consumption")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "wh")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r.kind == "load_curve" and r.direction == "consumption")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "watts")
